Host health
panels.description: Fleet health posture and per-site outliers
Share of healthy hosts per site once hosts unhealthy only through the Maintenance probe are discounted.

targets.expr: (max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"}) - clamp_min((sum by ($site_label) (max by ($site_label, in_use) (${metric_prefix}_hosts_health_status_count{job=~"$job",fresh="true",healthy="false"})) or 0 * max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})) - (sum by ($site_label) (max by ($site_label, in_use, probe_target) (${metric_prefix}_hosts_unhealthy_by_probe_id_count{job=~"$job",fresh="true",probe_id="Maintenance"})) or 0 * max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})), 0)) / max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})

panels.title: Healthy host percentage by site, excluding maintenance

panels.description: The same ratio once hosts classified SuppressExternalAlerting are discounted.

targets.expr: (max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"}) - clamp_min((sum by ($site_label) (max by ($site_label, in_use) (${metric_prefix}_hosts_health_status_count{job=~"$job",fresh="true",healthy="false"})) or 0 * max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})) - (sum by ($site_label) (max by ($site_label, in_use) (${metric_prefix}_hosts_unhealthy_by_classification_count{job=~"$job",fresh="true",classification="SuppressExternalAlerting"})) or 0 * max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})), 0)) / max by ($site_label) (${metric_prefix}_machines_total{job=~"$job",fresh="true"})

API service level
panels.description: Request availability and latency per site
Share of API requests that returned OK, per site. Every non-OK status counts as unavailable, including caller errors.

targets.expr: 1 - (sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job",grpc_status_code!~"0|Ok|OK"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Availability by site

panels.description: The same ratio with caller-fault statuses such as NotFound and InvalidArgument treated as successful responses.

targets.expr: 1 - (sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job",grpc_status_code!~"0|Ok|OK",grpc_status_code!~"Cancelled|InvalidArgument|NotFound|AlreadyExists|PermissionDenied|Unauthenticated|ResourceExhausted|FailedPrecondition|Aborted|OutOfRange"}[$__rate_interval])) or 0 * sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))) / sum by ($site_label) (rate(${metric_prefix}_api_grpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{job=~"$job"}[$__rate_interval]))

list.description: Prefix on NICo core metric names. carbide by default; a site that sets the alternative metric prefix also emits the same metrics under nico.

list.description: Label that identifies a site on the series this datasource serves. Use forge_site on a central Prometheus that receives several sites through remote-write or federation: the NICo observability bundle sets forge_site as each site's external label, and Prometheus attaches external labels only when data leaves the server. Querying a single site's own Prometheus directly leaves forge_site empty, so set this to job there.
list.label: Site label
list.name: site_label
